items.title: Jeff – Jev-compatible 0.8B decision models, trained at home, ~30 ms
items.summary: The Jeff project has released a new set of decision models that are compatible with Jev, allowing developers to train models at home with a latency of approximately 30 ms. This development could democratize access to AI model training and enhance local deployment capabilities for engineers.

items.title: MicroLLM Lab – Try 7 tiny LLM's in the browser
items.summary: MicroLLM Lab has launched an interactive platform where users can experiment with seven small language models directly in their browser. This initiative showcases the potential for lightweight LLMs to be utilized in web applications, making AI more accessible to developers.

items.title: World Labs Is Joining AMD
items.summary: World Labs has announced its acquisition by AMD, aiming to enhance AI capabilities and hardware integration. This merger is significant for engineers focusing on AI hardware optimization and could lead to advancements in AI processing technologies.

items.title: Cf: The Agentic CLI for the Cloudflare API
items.summary: Cloudflare has introduced the Agentic CLI, a command-line interface designed to streamline interactions with the Cloudflare API. This tool will benefit web developers by simplifying the management of Cloudflare services and enhancing automation capabilities.

items.title: Parley: Federated, decentralised chat that speaks plain IRC
items.summary: Parley has launched a federated and decentralized chat platform that utilizes plain IRC protocols, promoting open communication standards. This project is important for developers interested in building resilient and privacy-focused communication tools.
